rfqRoute: UK buyers using broad box searches should be routed to a project brief first, not a price promise.
The brief should separate printed retail boxes, business packaging boxes, corrugated mailer cartons and shipping mailer boxes.
Required inputs: product size, box style, quantity range, material direction, artwork status, finishing needs and destination market.
If the buyer is comparing UK local supply with an overseas source factory, the next useful step is a structured RFQ review, not a generic catalogue page.
After this route is published, evaluate it with GA4 key events and Ads search terms before changing bids or budget.
